title: uwu entities [TBS]
description: Turns every entity into a UWU variant!!
body:
This mod turns every the broken script entity into a UWU variant of themselves!! Instead of having to wait for april fools to see these textures you can see them right out of this resource pack!!!

Nothingiswatching is the only one that i've seen that is currently broken right now, please dont mind that :>
